env_outputs:
1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""
3	Robust template for multi-sheet Excel pivot reports.
4	Adapt column names, file paths, and reconciliation rules per task.
5	"""
6	import pandas as pd
7	import openpyxl
8	from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
9	import sys
10	
11	def run_report(transactions_path, catalog_path, output_path):
12	    # 1. Load
13	    df = pd.read_excel(transactions_path)
14	    catalog = pd.read_excel(catalog_path) # Adjust if PDF/CSV
15	    
16	    # 2. Clean & Cast
17	    df["PRODUCT_ID"] = df["PRODUCT_ID"].astype(str).str.strip()
18	    catalog["PRODUCT_ID"] = catalog["PRODUCT_ID"].astype(str).str.strip()
19	    for col in ["QUANTITY", "UNIT_PRICE", "UNIT_COST"]:
20	        if col in df.columns:
21	            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")
22	            
23	    # 3. Reconcile
24	    initial_rows = len(df)
25	    df = df[df["QUANTITY"] > 0]
26	    print(f"Dropped {initial_rows - len(df)} non-positive quantity rows.")
27	    
28	    df = df.merge(catalog, on="PRODUCT_ID", how="left", suffixes=("", "_cat"))
29	    unmatched = df[df["UNIT_PRICE"].isna()]
30	    print(f"Unmatched PRODUCT_IDs: {len(unmatched)}")
31	    df = df.dropna(subset=["UNIT_PRICE"])
32	    
33	    # 4. Compute
34	    df["REVENUE"] = df["QUANTITY"] * df["UNIT_PRICE"]
35	    df["PROFIT"] = df["REVENUE"] - (df["QUANTITY"] * df["UNIT_COST"])
36	    df["MARGIN_PCT"] = (df["PROFIT"] / df["REVENUE"].replace(0, pd.NA)).round(4)
37	    
38	    # 5. Write
39	    with pd.ExcelWriter(output_path, engine="openpyxl") as writer:
40	        df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name="SourceData", index=False)
41	        
42	        # Example pivots with EXPLICIT COLUMN RENAMING
43	        rev_cat = df.groupby("CATEGORY")["REVENUE"].sum().reset_index()
44	        rev_cat = rev_cat.rename(columns={"REVENUE": "Total Revenue"})
45	        rev_cat.to_excel(writer, sheet_name="Revenue by Category", index=False)
46	        
47	        units_reg = df.groupby("REGION")["QUANTITY"].sum().reset_index()
48	        units_reg = units_reg.rename(columns={"QUANTITY": "Total Units"})
49	        units_reg.to_excel(writer, sheet_name="Units by Region", index=False)
50	        
51	    print(f"Report saved to {output_path}")
52	    verify_report(output_path)
53	
54	def verify_report(output_path):
55	    """Read back and print headers/counts to catch verifier mismatches early."""
56	    xls = pd.ExcelFile(output_path)
57	    for sheet in xls.sheet_names:
58	        df = pd.read_excel(output_path, sheet_name=sheet)
59	        print(f"[VERIFY] {sheet}: {len(df)} rows, cols={list(df.columns)}, dtypes={df.dtypes.to_dict()}")
60	
61	if __name__ == "__main__":
62	    if len(sys.argv) == 4:
63	        run_report(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
64	    else:
65	        print("Usage: python3 pivot_report_template.py <transactions> <catalog> <output>")
66
